title: Pokemon Crystal preparation tasks, in no released suite

evals.title: Solve the Kabuto panel in the Ruins of Alph

objective.description: Solve the stone picture panel in this chamber of the Ruins of Alph and follow where it leads.

evals.start: Ruins of Alph Kabuto Chamber, first settled frame after entering from outside. The panel is unsolved.
success: Reach the Ruins of Alph inner chamber after the Kabuto panel is solved.
failure: The decision cap or the token budget is reached before the inner chamber.
The party blacks out. Infrastructure errors are recorded separately.
variants: One start. Timing variants are added only if a pilot shows start sensitivity.
requirements: Capture the start with scripts/prepare_gen2_fixtures.py from a fresh game on the frame-locked clock.

evals.task_family: Solve a sliding picture puzzle on a separate screen
evals.agent_goal: Solve the stone picture panel in this chamber of the Ruins of Alph and follow where it leads.
scenario_details: Party, bag and badges are whatever the PokeSim story run holds when it first enters the chamber, shortly after the Zephyr Badge.
The clock is locked to emulated frames and saved next to the start. Time of day is recorded with the fixture.
open_questions: The assisted executor has no Gen II puzzle screen yet. The panel is played with raw buttons until it does.
evals.measures: Read a scrambled picture, plan tile moves on a 4 by 4 board with an empty border and finish the image.

milestones.description: Stand at the stone panel on the chamber's back wall.
Complete the Kabuto picture.
Reach the inner chamber below.

evals.title: Wake the legendary beasts in the Burned Tower

objective.description: Explore the Burned Tower in Ecruteak City, find a way to its basement and see what rests there.

evals.start: Burned Tower 1F, first settled frame of the first entry from Ecruteak City that the PokeSim story run survives. The rival is unbeaten, the floor has not collapsed and the beasts are asleep.
success: The three legendary beasts are released in the basement.
failure: The decision cap or the token budget is reached before the beasts are released.
The party blacks out. Infrastructure errors are recorded separately.
variants: One start. Timing variants are added only if a pilot shows start sensitivity.
requirements: Capture the start with scripts/prepare_gen2_fixtures.py from a fresh game on the frame-locked clock.
A scripted reference reaches every milestone from the saved start.
evals.task_family: Trigger a scripted fall through a collapsing floor and finish a multi-room scene
evals.agent_goal: Explore the Burned Tower in Ecruteak City, find a way to its basement and see what rests there.
scenario_details: Party, bag and badges are whatever the PokeSim story run holds when it enters the tower for the start.
The story run's first entry lost the rival battle and blacked out, so that recording moved to blackouts/ and the start is the next entry, after the Pokemon Center healed the party.
The rival battle on 1F is part of the task. Wild encounters stay on.
open_questions: Check in a pilot whether the rival battle dominates the task for weak models.
Event 1733 stayed clear after the lost rival battle of the first entry and was set after the won battle of the second, so the rival milestone reads it as a win. The pret script would settle this.
evals.measures: Find the scripted rival encounter, win it, fall through the floor and walk the basement to the beasts.

milestones.description: Win the rival battle on 1F.
The 1F floor collapses after the rival battle.
Reach the Burned Tower basement.
Release the three legendary beasts.

Open the door to the transmitter room.
Clear the hideout.
